user.description:
Create an application in [NCP console → Maps → Application]({ncp_url}), enable **Geocoding** and **Directions 5**, and enter its key ID and key. They are used for geocoding and car directions.

Everything else needs no keys: keyword and nearby search, transit, walking, and cycling directions (with alternatives and steps), place details, and live arrivals use Naver Map's web (unofficial) and may stop working if Naver changes or blocks it.

Create an application in [NCP console → Maps → Application]({ncp_url}), enable **Geocoding** and **Directions 5**, and enter its key ID and key. They are used for geocoding and car directions.

Everything else needs no keys: keyword and nearby search, transit, walking, and cycling directions (with alternatives and steps), place details, and live arrivals use Naver Map's web (unofficial) and may stop working if Naver changes or blocks it.

error.invalid_ncp_auth: NAVER Cloud Platform rejected the Maps API key (HTTP 401). Check the key and that Geocoding is enabled for the application.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Naver API. Check your network and try again.

search_place.name: Search place
search_place.description: Searches Naver Map for a place by keyword and returns up to the top 5 results, each with coordinates, distance, addresses, and a map link. Like the Naver Map app, places near a point (default: home) come first.

query.name: Query
query.description: Search keyword, e.g. a place or business name.

near.name: Near
near.description: Rank results around this point: an entity with a location (e.g. a person) or a latitude/longitude value. Defaults to the home location.

search_nearby.name: Search nearby
search_nearby.description: Searches for places of a category or keyword around a center point, returning up to 10 results ordered by distance, each with its Naver Place ID when available.

center.name: Center
center.description: The point to search around: an entity holding a location or a latitude/longitude value.

category.name: Category
category.description: A place category to search for. Provide either a category or a query, not both.

query.name: Query
query.description: A search keyword. Provide either a query or a category, not both.

geocode_address.name: Geocode address
geocode_address.description: Converts an address into WGS84 coordinates, returning the best match with its jibun/road address, postal code, and a map link.

query.name: Address
query.description: The address to geocode, e.g. a road-name or lot-number address.

get_place_details.name: Get place details
get_place_details.description: Looks up a place's Naver Place summary: the business-hours status, visitor and blog review counts, photos, booking/order/delivery/Naver Pay availability, and a link to the place in Naver Map. Uses Naver Map's undocumented web API (best effort).

query.name: Place name
query.description: Name of the place to look up, e.g. a search_place result's place_name. Use this or a place ID.

near.name: Near
near.description: An entity or a latitude/longitude value near the place, to pick the right branch. Defaults to the home location.

place_id.name: Place ID
place_id.description: Naver Place ID, e.g. from a previous response. Use this or a place name.

get_transit_arrivals.name: Get transit arrivals
get_transit_arrivals.description: Returns realtime arrivals at a bus stop or a subway station: for each line its next vehicles with arrival time, remaining time, and (bus) remaining stops, crowding, and low-floor flag. Uses Naver Map's undocumented web API (best effort).

stop_id.name: Stop ID
stop_id.description: Naver bus stop ID or subway station ID (one per line), e.g. a get_directions transit step's stop_id.

route_ids.name: Route IDs
route_ids.description: Only these lines, e.g. a transit step's route_ids.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Subway only: up or down, e.g. a transit step's way.

get_directions.name: Get directions
get_directions.description: Builds a Naver Map route link between an origin and destination (with optional waypoints) and returns the per-leg points plus a best-effort travel time and distance.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: An entity holding the origin location (person, device_tracker, zone, sensor, ...) or a latitude/longitude value.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: An entity holding the destination location or a latitude/longitude value.

waypoints.name: Waypoints
waypoints.description: Up to 5 stops, each an entity or a latitude/longitude value. Not allowed with the public transit mode.

mode.name: Travel mode
mode.description: car, transit (public transit), walk, or bicycle.

include_geometry.name: Include route line
include_geometry.description: Also return the route line as `geometry` ([latitude, longitude] points), or null when it is unavailable.

include_steps.name: Include route steps
include_steps.description: Also return `steps`: turn-by-turn directions, or for public transit each walk and ride with its lines, stations, and times; null when unavailable.

include_alternatives.name: Include alternative routes
include_alternatives.description: Transit and car only: also return every route offered as `alternatives` — for cars the best, fastest, and toll-free routes (with toll and fuel cost), for transit each route with its labels (best, minimum_duration, minimum_transfer, minimum_walking), vehicle types, walking time, and fare. Null for walk and bicycle.

api_error.message: The Naver API request failed. Check the log for details.

point_input_missing.message: Specify an entity or coordinates for {role}.

invalid_location.message: Invalid location for {role}: {value}. Expected a latitude/longitude pair.

too_many_waypoints.message: Too many waypoints ({count}). Naver Map allows at most {max}.

nearby_input.message: Provide exactly one of category or query for the nearby search.

place_input.message: Provide exactly one of a place name (query) or a place ID.

transit_no_waypoints.message: Public transit routes do not support waypoints. Remove the waypoints or choose another mode.
